name: March Product Updates: GPT-3 Document Extraction, OCR Confidence Scores, and Bulk CSV Downloads
post-body:
While Daylight Saving Time may have stolen an hour of sleep this weekend, Sensible’s new natural language processing (NLP) capabilities, bulk CSV downloads, and OCR confidence scores will give you back that time (and then some).

For the full list of changes, check out our changelog.

Question method now powered by GPT-3

Our Question method is now powered by GPT-3 so you can create complex queries like "when is the rent due? don't include details about grace periods.”

🤐 Shhh, don’t tell anyone but we’re working on something new with GPT-3 that we’re excited to share with you. Email us for a preview.

Extract tables using natural language

Query documents for table data without specifying where the table begins or the exact layout. Provide an overall description of the table (ex. “insured vehicles”), along with a description about the column you want to extract and any filtering or formatting instruction (ex. “vehicle make (not model)”). Take a look:

OCR confidence scores

Eliminate doubts about the quality of your OCR-scanned documents. Track confidence scores on your extracted text. Set up validations to confirm the extracted data meets your OCR quality requirements and ensure the source text is readable and accurate.

Download your data as a CSV

While Excel is great, open standards are even better. Now you can not only download a single extraction as a CSV, but also download multiple extractions in bulk as a single CSV via Sensible's API. 

‍

👋  Interested in learning more about these features? Book time with a Sensible expert or read the changelog.
